name: Huygen Hybrid SEO + HN Latest Auto Publisher v11.1 Evidence Gated Draft Safe

nodes.name: Twice Daily 09:00 SEO / 20:00 News Trigger (IST)
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 09:00 and 16:00 using workflow timezone Asia/Kolkata.

nodes.name: Decide Content Mode
nodes.notes: Uses Asia/Kolkata explicitly so 09:00 selects SEO and 16:00 selects news even when the server/container runs in UTC.

nodes.name: Fetch Hacker News Signals
nodes.notes: Retry policy: retries up to 4 times with 15s between attempts.

nodes.name: Build News-Inspired Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds a date-safe Hacker News slug. If a title already ends in the publication year, the workflow appends only month-day, preventing slugs such as 2026-2026-07-10.

nodes.name: Gemini Generate Article
nodes.notes:
High-availability Gemini call. Defaults to gemini-2.5-flash to avoid gemini-3.5-flash high-demand spikes. Retries up to 4 times.
Retry policy: retries up to 4 times with 15s between attempts.
Uses Interactions API structured JSON output with a strict article schema to prevent malformed JSON/HTML quote failures.
v9.7: Request body is prepared in a Code node and referenced as $json.geminiRequestBody. This avoids n8n 2.x invalid-syntax errors from deeply nested inline object expressions.

nodes.name: Parse Gemini Draft
nodes.notes: v9.1 strict length guard: sanitizes HTML, counts locally, and pads to at least max(MIN_WORD_COUNT + 150, 1000). Publishing requires local wordCount > MIN_WORD_COUNT.

nodes.name: Gemini Quality Gate
nodes.notes:
High-availability Gemini quality gate. Uses GEMINI_QUALITY_MODEL or GEMINI_MODEL; default gemini-2.5-flash-lite. Retries transient demand errors.
Retry policy: maximum 2 attempts, 5 seconds apart, 60-second timeout per attempt (about 125 seconds worst case).
Uses Interactions API structured JSON output with a strict quality schema.
v9.7: Request body is prepared in a Code node and referenced as $json.geminiRequestBody. This avoids n8n 2.x invalid-syntax errors from deeply nested inline object expressions.
v9.8: Reduced quality-gate latency. The node no longer waits through four 120-second attempts.

nodes.name: Prepare Marble Payload
nodes.notes:
Builds the final Marble payload, omits invalid cover images, and normalizes slugs idempotently. News slugs always end in one publication date and never duplicate the year.
Compatibility v10.3: URL validation is implemented without the global URL constructor for n8n 2.x task-runner compatibility.

nodes.name: Article Approved? Run Image Pipeline
nodes.notes: Runs the full Pexels image search and proxy validation for every approved article, including AUTO_PUBLISH_ENABLED=false dry runs. Actual Marble publishing remains gated later by shouldPublish.

nodes.name: Upsert to Marble
nodes.notes: Idempotent Marble write. Uses POST for new slugs and PATCH for existing slugs. Returns all HTTP statuses so the workflow can recover from 409 collisions, 404 races, 429s, and 5xx errors.

nodes.name: Revalidate Website
nodes.notes: Calls the normalized same-origin revalidation URL. The secret is sent only in x-revalidate-secret and is intentionally excluded from the URL/query string.

parameters.content:
## v11.1 evidence-gated, draft-safe changes

- Exactly two IST triggers: 09:00 SEO draft and 20:00 HN draft.
- EDITORIAL_CLEANUP_MODE=true by default blocks every Marble publish even if old auto-publish variables remain enabled.
- Morning mode refuses to generate without an approved MORNING_EDITORIAL_BRIEF_JSON containing real first-party evidence, a real original asset, and a distinct angle.
- News mode selects one HN story, fetches its primary source, and fetches HN discussion context.
- The exact HN title must lead the article title and H1.
- Unrelated HN stories, generic AI reframing, studio promotion, and filler padding are rejected.
- The parser no longer appends reusable checklists or production-readiness paragraphs.
- Human review is required by default before Marble publishing (REQUIRE_HUMAN_REVIEW=true).
- Keep EDITORIAL_CLEANUP_MODE=true throughout the current content cleanup. After cleanup, turn it off only for a specifically reviewed run.

## v9.5 dry-run image pipeline fix
- Fixes empty Pexels diagnostics (`statusCode: null`, `resultCount: 0`, no selection error) caused by the image branch being skipped whenever `AUTO_PUBLISH_ENABLED=false`.
- Every quality-approved article now runs through Pexels search, selection, same-origin proxy verification, and fallback resolution during dry runs.
- Actual Marble writes are still blocked unless `AUTO_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true` and all publishing requirements pass.
- Adds explicit diagnostics: `imagePipelineExecuted`, `imagePipelineMode`, `pexelsEnabled`, `pexelsApiKeyPresent`, `imageCandidateFound`, proxy status, and selector rejection details.
- Keeps multi-query page-1 search, universal Pexels response parsing, strict 800+ words, image attribution, safe fallback, Marble upsert, revalidation, and public-page verification.

## v9.8 Fast Quality Gate
- Gemini Quality Gate timeout reduced to 60 seconds.
- Retries reduced from 4 to 2.
- Wait reduced to 5 seconds.
- Quality JSON output capped at 1024 tokens.
- Worst-case quality-node delay is about 125 seconds instead of about 8 minutes 45 seconds.

## v9.9 image guarantee
The selector now picks the first usable Pexels API result without dimension/relevance disqualification. If proxy HEAD verification fails, the original Pexels CDN URL is used directly, so returned photos are not discarded.

nodes.name: v11.1 Evidence-Gated Editorial Safety Notes
nodes.notes: v10.0 production workflow: structured Gemini requests, strict >800-word local gate, fast quality retries, Pexels image selection with direct fallback, dry-run image validation, Marble upsert/revalidation, and idempotent slug normalization that prevents duplicated years/dates.

nodes.name: Prepare Pexels Image Search
nodes.notes: Builds a concrete Pexels photo query from Gemini imageSearchQuery, the primary keyword, title, and content cluster. The Pexels key is read only from n8n environment variables.

nodes.name: Has Pexels API Key?
nodes.notes: True branch searches Pexels. False branch uses a safe same-origin fallback so a missing image key cannot crash the blog page.

nodes.name: Pexels Search Photos
nodes.notes: Pexels page-1 search for each concise query. v9.4 keeps full JSON responses and passes them to a universal response parser.

nodes.name: Select Relevant Pexels Image
nodes.notes: Permissive selector: picks the first unused usable photo returned by the Pexels API. No dimension, relevance, or strict CDN-host eligibility filter can reduce 120 returned photos to zero.

nodes.name: Has Relevant Pexels Image?
nodes.notes: True branch verifies the same-origin image proxy. False branch preserves publication with a safe fallback cover.

nodes.name: Verify Same-Origin Image Proxy
nodes.notes: Optional HEAD verification of the same-origin proxy. Failure no longer discards the selected Pexels photo; v9.9 falls back to the original Pexels CDN URL.

nodes.name: Use Safe Cover Fallback
nodes.notes: Preserves publishing context when Pexels is disabled, the API key is missing, the quota is exhausted, or no suitable image is found.

nodes.name: Finalize Verified Cover Image
nodes.notes: Uses the verified same-origin proxy when available. If the proxy HEAD check fails, it keeps the selected Pexels CDN URL directly instead of discarding the image.

nodes.name: Image Ready to Publish?
nodes.notes: If REQUIRE_COVER_IMAGE=true and no verified/fallback image exists, the workflow returns a clear skipped result instead of publishing a broken post.

nodes.name: Prepare Gemini Article Request
nodes.notes: Builds the Gemini Interactions API request body in JavaScript. The HTTP node receives only a simple field reference, avoiding n8n expression-parser failures caused by large inline JSON schemas.

nodes.name: Prepare Gemini Quality Request
nodes.notes: Builds the structured-output quality request outside the HTTP Request expression editor.

nodes.name: Prepare Gemini Recovery Article Request
nodes.notes: Builds the recovery article request body outside the HTTP Request expression editor.

nodes.name: Prepare Gemini Recovery Quality Request
nodes.notes: Builds the recovery quality request body outside the HTTP Request expression editor.

nodes.name: Wait Before Marble Verification
nodes.notes: Small read-after-write delay before querying Marble by the canonical ID/slug returned by the write response.

nodes.name: Fetch Primary HN Source
nodes.notes: Retry policy: retries up to 4 times with 15s between attempts.

nodes.notes: Retry policy: retries up to 4 times with 15s between attempts.
